name: Complete Webform Exporter
description: Downloads a webform submission — spreadsheet plus its attached files — as a ZIP, individually or in bulk.
project_description:
Complete Webform Exporter is designed to make exporting webform submissions incredibly easy for users. Here's how it helps:

 
 Single-Click Export: Users can export their webform submissions effortlessly with just one click. 
 Bulk Submission Download: It allows users to select and download multiple submissions at once, saving time and effort. 
 Individual Submission Download: Users can also choose to download each submission separately, providing flexibility. 
 Includes Attachments: All attachments submitted with the webforms are included in the export, ensuring no information is missed. 
 Comprehensive Zip File: The exported submissions, along with attachments and submitted information, are neatly packaged into a single zip file for convenience. 
 
 This tool simplifies the process of managing and accessing webform data, making it user-friendly and efficient.

 

 Features 
 
 Provide a facility to export submission of the webform result along with attachments information in a single zip file. 
 Provide Bulk Export Webform Submissions with their attachment in zip. 
 User can manage download access via "Download any webform submission managed files" permission. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 
 Webform 
 PhpSpreadsheet 
 
 Similar projects
